scroll_snap.label: Scroll Snap
scroll_snap.description:
Scroll Snap makes the viewport stop on a specific position of a section when scrolling ends.

To avoid glitches and conflicts, we recommend not to use Scroll Snap together with animations or Motion effects.

selectors.body: height: 100vh; overflow: auto; scroll-snap-type: y mandatory;
